'''Willowbark''' is a fairly common herbal medicine. It is used to treat pain, particularly headaches.{{ref|{{twotc}}, willowbark}}

[[Tam]] and [[Rand]] keep some willowbark among their bags of medicines.{{ref/book|1|5}} [[Mat]], who keeps willowbark in his saddlebags, offers willowbark tea to [[Perrin]] after he speaks to the wolves.{{ref/book|2|14}} [[Nynaeve]] tells [[Thom]] to ask [[Rendra]] for willowbark or [[acem]] to relieve his bruised head.{{ref/book|4|52}} Nynaeve used willowbark after channeling too much at [[Algarin Pendaloan]]'s manor.{{ref/book|11|20}}

==Parallel==
Willow bark is a medicine that has ben used since ancient times to alleviate pain.<ref>History of Aspirin.[https://pharmaceutical-journal.com/article/infographics/a-history-of-aspirin]</ref> The active ingredients were developed and commercialised into [[wikipedia:aspirin|aspirin]].
